issues.explanation: Public policy methods and User::membershipFor lack PHPDoc though conventions require PHPDoc on touched public methods.

conventions.evidence: Migrations have reversible down() (2026_10_29_035213_create_entities_table.php:42-45, 2026_10_29_035214_create_entity_memberships_table.php:81-84), $fillable set deliberately (app/Models/Entity.php:36, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:90), authorization via policies, docs synced (docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md:9); deduct for missing PHPDoc on policy methods and User::membershipFor

requirements.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:38-67 getRouteKeyName=slug, memberships/users/owner; app/Models/EntityMembership.php:96-143 casts role=>UserRole, scopes owner/admin/employee, entity/user; app/Models/UserRole.php:7-10 manageable=[Admin,Employee]; app/Models/User.php:166-184 memberships/entities/membershipFor; factories EntityFactory:347-352 and EntityMembershipFactory:381-409 with owner/admin/employee states; migrations entities_slug_unique + softDeletes, entity_memberships FKs cascade + role default employee + owner_seq storedAs + uniques entity_memberships_entity_user_unique/entity_memberships_one_owner (472-474); EntityPolicy:290-319 and EntityMembershipPolicy:228-261 match all auth rules including owner-delete-never and self-removal; docs/database-schema.md:544-545 replaces owner_membership_id

scope.evidence: All hunks serve the task: CHANGELOG.md:9, app/Models/*, app/Policies/*, database/factories/*, database/migrations/2026_10_29_*, docs/database-schema.md; no routes, pages, middleware, or unrelated refactors

security.evidence: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:290-319 create=true, view=member, update/delete=Owner|Admin, manageSettings=Owner-only; app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:228-261 view=member, assignRole=Owner|Admin, delete blocks owner-role first then self-or-Owner|Admin; $fillable whitelists in app/Models/Entity.php:36 and EntityMembership.php:90; no Livewire, no unescaped output, no secrets

simplicity.evidence: Minimum direct implementation: 50-line Entity, 70-line EntityMembership, 20-line UserRole enum, thin policies delegating delete->update; no service/repository layers, no speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or *Test.php hunks; conventions.md tdd requires a test for every feature plus unauthorized/tamper paths — nothing to evaluate for coverage

review.summary: Implements the full tenancy persistence contract — entities, memberships with DB-enforced single owner, models, factories, and both policies — with correct edge cases and docs sync. Missing tests violates the project's test-first gate, so it needs changes before merging despite correct implementation.
